full_prompt_en: A square, softly focused black-and-white portrait brings a young woman's face very close to the viewer. Her head tilts slightly downward and toward the right, while her eyes look outward from under a thick, tousled fringe. Dark wavy hair fills the top and left margins, making a loose shadowed frame around the face. The cheek on the left side of the picture is softly illuminated, and the bridge of the nose catches a pale vertical highlight. Her lips are closed and relaxed, with a thoughtful expression rather than an obvious smile. A hand rises beside the lower right of her face, its fingers gently bent near the cheek or hair. The hand is blurred at its edges and partly lost in the dark surrounding area. Dark clothing and curls merge beneath the chin and along the left edge, so the image offers almost no visible setting. The crop cuts through the hair at the top and shoulder at the side, placing all attention on the eyes, cheek, lips, and hand. Light is diffuse and modest, likely entering from the left, and it falls away gradually into deep brownish-black shadow on the other side. Midtones are warm gray and slightly velvety rather than stark white. Fine photographic grain and a faint soft-focus veil are present over skin and hair, while the eyes retain the strongest clarity. There is no hard rim light, bright background, or sharply described costume. The nearly monochrome palette and intimate framing create a quiet, reflective mood. No readable words appear. The whole photograph feels like a fleeting private moment, with expression carried through subtle gaze and tonal gradation.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形柔焦黑白肖像把一位年轻女子的脸拉得非常近。她的头稍向下、向右倾，眼睛从浓密而凌乱的刘海下向外望。深色波浪发填满上缘和左缘，在面部周围形成松散的暗框。画面左侧的脸颊受到柔光照亮，鼻梁接住一条浅色竖向亮部。嘴唇轻闭、放松，神情沉思而非明显微笑。一只手在面部右下方抬起，手指微弯，靠近脸颊或头发。手的边缘柔化，部分消失在周围暗区。深色衣服和卷发在下巴下方及左边缘合并，因此影像几乎不交代场所。裁切穿过上方头发和侧边肩部，把注意力集中在眼睛、脸颊、嘴唇和手上。光线漫散而克制，似乎从左侧进入，并逐渐落入另一侧深棕黑阴影。中间灰阶温暖、略有绒感，而非锐利纯白。皮肤和头发上有细胶片颗粒与轻柔焦纱，眼睛则保有最强清晰度。没有坚硬边缘光、明亮背景或描述明确的服饰。近乎单色的配色和亲密画框营造安静、内省的情绪。没有可读文字。整幅照片像转瞬即逝的私人时刻，由细微目光和明暗过渡承载表情。
style_prompt_en: Soft-focus monochrome photography gives a tightly cropped organic form a warm, velvety tonal range. Dark irregular framing shapes surround a luminous pale center, with clarity reserved for a few expressive details while nearby edges dissolve gently. Diffuse side light moves across rounded surfaces without hard highlights, then recedes into near-black shadow. Fine grain and a faint old-film veil remain visible, especially in mid-gray transitions. A secondary soft shape near the lower edge adds intimacy without pulling focus from the center. The composition is close, quiet, and restrained, using gaze-like emphasis and subtle tonal gradation in place of an explicit setting.
style_prompt_zh: 柔焦单色摄影赋予紧凑裁切的有机形体温暖、绒感的明度范围。深色不规则框形包围发亮的浅色中心，清晰度留给少数富于表情的细节，邻近边缘则轻轻溶开。漫射侧光滑过圆润表面，不形成硬亮点，随后退入近黑阴影。细颗粒与淡淡旧胶片薄雾仍可见，尤其在中灰过渡中。下缘附近的次要柔软形体增加亲近感，却不抢走中心注意力。构图贴近、安静而克制，以类似目光的重点和细腻明暗变化代替明确场所。
theme_en: A contemplative young woman in a close monochrome portrait
theme_zh: 沉思中的年轻女子黑白近景肖像
name: Gertrude Kasebier
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
